entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: The non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: X3D
entities.note: Extensible 3D standard for declarative 3D graphics on the Web.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The latest major version of the X3D standard, integrating closely with HTML5.

entities.name: X3D 3.3
entities.note: The previous major version of the X3D standard.

entities.name: VRML
entities.note: Virtual Reality Modeling Language, the predecessor to X3D.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: A pure JavaScript WebGL X3D browser that fully supports X3D components and VRML.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: An open-source JavaScript framework that integrates X3D nodes directly into HTML5 DOM.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: A cross-platform 3D and 2D game engine supporting X3D and VRML natively.

entities.name: FreeWRL
entities.note: An open-source X3D and VRML browser available for multiple desktop and mobile platforms.

entities.name: InstantReality
entities.note: A high-performance mixed reality framework developed by Fraunhofer IGD.

entities.name: Cobweb
entities.note: A predecessor to X_ITE, providing an X3D browser in JavaScript and WebGL.

entities.name: Xj3D
entities.note: An open-source Java implementation of the X3D specification.

entities.name: BS Contact
entities.note: A commercial X3D and VRML viewer developed by Bitmanagement Software.

entities.name: Octaga
entities.note: A high-performance commercial X3D player originally developed by Octaga Visual Solutions.

entities.name: Titania
entities.note: An open-source X3D editor and browser developed by Holger Seelig.

entities.name: view3dscene
entities.note: A viewer for 3D models (X3D, VRML, glTF) built with Castle Game Engine.

entities.name: H3DAPI
entities.note: An open-source haptics software development platform that uses X3D and OpenGL.

entities.name: Fraunhofer IGD
entities.note: A German research institute heavily involved in developing X3DOM and InstantReality.

entities.name: Michalis Kamburelis
entities.note: Lead developer and maintainer of the Castle Game Engine.

entities.name: Holger Seelig
entities.note: Creator and maintainer of X_ITE, Cobweb, and Titania.

entities.name: Johannes Behr
entities.note: A key researcher at Fraunhofer IGD who led the development of X3DOM and InstantReality.

entities.name: Bitmanagement Software
entities.note: A German company that develops the BS Contact X3D viewer.

entities.name: Octaga Visual Solutions
entities.note: A Norwegian company that developed the Octaga X3D player.

entities.name: SenseGraphics
entities.note: A company that develops and maintains H3DAPI.

entities.name: Naval Postgraduate School
entities.note: An academic institution that maintains various X3D tools and resources.

entities.name: Yumetech
entities.note: A company that contributed significantly to the development of Xj3D.

entities.name: HTML5
entities.note: The fifth major version of HTML, which X3DOM and X_ITE integrate with.

entities.name: WebGL
entities.note: A JavaScript API for rendering interactive 2D and 3D graphics, used by X3DOM and X_ITE.

entities.name: WebXR
entities.note: A web API for virtual and augmented reality devices, supported by modern web X3D players.

entities.name: OpenGL
entities.note: A cross-language, cross-platform API for rendering 2D and 3D vector graphics.

entities.name: Andreas Plesch
entities.note: A prominent contributor to the X3DOM project.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: A key figure in the Web3D Consortium and Naval Postgraduate School.
